commitments: This amendment is published before the new score is computed.
It is the only revision to unit selection: whatever the new calibration pilot shows, the resulting sets go to the hold-out tests unchanged.
Results under the original score are reported in the supplement for comparison.
data_seen_before_amendment: Stage 3 calibration scores, sets and exploratory pilot (calibration test half). The hold-out set has not been evaluated by any study model (holdout_access_log.jsonl).

evidence.cornet_s_V4: configural set 80 of 256 channels (31%); pilot: configural lesion took grid-control accuracy to 0.069 (floor)
evidence.resnet50_swsl_layer3: configural set 60 channels, damage 0.246 (random size-matched sets rarely reached it); pilot CR intact 0.542, after configural lesion 0.690, random 0.583 [0.475, 0.698]

new_rule.configural_test: one-sided category-stratified bootstrap over localizer objects, 10000 resamples, p = (1 + #{I_CR_boot <= 0}) / (1 + 10000); Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.05; set bounded to 1-40% of site channels as before
new_rule.local_set: channels with I_CR <= site median, ranked by local score P_scr - P_scr(-c) (unchanged), size chosen to match the configural set's damage
new_rule.primary_score: I_CR(c) = CR_p(intact) - CR_p(channel c zero-ablated); positive = removing c lowers configural reliance
new_rule.primary_site: reliable site with the largest summed I_CR over its configural set
new_rule.probability_cr: CR_p = 1 - (Pbar_scr - 1/16) / (Pbar_grid - 1/16); Pbar = mean over localizer objects of true-category probability (16-way), scrambles averaged within object first
new_rule.reliability: split-half Spearman of I_CR between calibration halves, Spearman-Brown corrected, >= 0.7 (unchanged rule, new score)
new_rule.unchanged: unit definition, zero ablation, damage definition, random size- and damage-matched controls (including the 100-closest fallback), selective set, all hypotheses, measures and statistics on the hold-out set

reason: The absolute score subtracts probability drops on scrambled from drops on intact objects. Intact objects start from a higher probability, so a channel that lowers both by the same proportion scores positive. The score therefore favoured generally important channels. The plan's stated principle is selection by causal effect on configural reliance; the new score measures exactly that, in the same form as the primary outcome CR. The same baseline confound led to CR replacing the absolute loss at the model level.

replaces.configural_test: one-sided one-sample t-test of per-object I_conf across localizer objects

sections_affected: Unit localisation: primary score and configural-set test
Lesion protocol: every ranking that used I_conf (local-set eligibility, dose-response, primary site)
